// cli profile of its module table, embedding its manifest (ADR-020 decision 29).
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/mutex-solutions/aiops-platform/dist"
	"github.com/mutex-solutions/aiops-platform/internal/aiopsctl"
	"github.com/mutex-solutions/aiops-platform/site/site"
)

func main() {
	reg, signed, lim, err := site.Load()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "aiopsctl: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	sigs := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(sigs, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	dir, _ := os.Getwd()
	os.Exit(aiopsctl.Run(context.Background(), os.Args[1:],
		aiopsctl.Process{In: os.Stdin, Out: os.Stdout, Err: os.Stderr, Environ: os.Environ(), Dir: dir, Files: os.DirFS("/"), Signals: sigs},
		aiopsctl.Distribution{Registry: reg, Signed: signed, Release: site.Release, Limits: lim, Shipped: dist.Shipped()}))
}
